class.name: ECSQuery
class.description: [ECSQuery] allows for defining complex filters to retrieve specific subsets of entities based on their component masks.

method.name: with_component
method.description: Adds a requirement that the entity MUST have the specified component bit.

method.name: without_component
method.description: Adds a requirement that the entity MUST NOT have the specified component bit.

method.name: execute
method.description: Performs the join and returns an array of matching entity IDs.
